name: Rizuhble's Pub Brawl Silver
rows: Getting poked out. Sell it once you're out of slots.
Getting burst when you go in. Sell it once you're out of slots.
Dying after Lifestrike? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.
Hexes and slows keep you off them.
Their gun carry is out-shooting you.
Most of their damage is gun.
Most of their damage is spirit.
A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.
Lycan Curse counts as your ult, so every wolf form gives you the barrier. Sell Spirit Shielding for this.
If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
Get Lifestrike right after Stalker, then carry on.
changes: Silencer (6.4k at 49.6k) out of core into the rich box; Duration Extender on Lycan Curse (1.6k at 20k) into Superior Duration (1.6k at 36.8k) in its place. Wolf form is 15s, so +28% is about 4s more wolf per ult, plus longer kick mark and bola root and 8% bullet resist. Pros take Superior Duration 25% late and the gun-tank builds (V1, Animals) have it core; Silencer is a late optional for them. Core drops from 49.6k to 46.4k, 12 slots.

Spikes unchanged: 4.8k gun at 5.6k (Close Quarters, Stalker, Point Blank), 4.8k health at 9.6k (Melee Lifesteal, Bullet Lifesteal, Lifestrike). Pro core still Stalker 98%, Melee Lifesteal 96%, Hunter's Aura 94%, Lifestrike 70%, Weighted Shots 43%, Berserker 54%.
Debuff Reducer (63% pro late) not added: no slot left without dropping a gun item, and Unstoppable is in counters.
Rich box is now Lucky Shot (sells Toxic Bullets) then Silencer (sells Weighted Shots).

Ability order: mobalytics build-stats grid: unlocks 1-2-3-4, Slam Fire 5-7, Lycan Curse 8-10 (54-91%), Bola last; same for the brawler style (wolf early), with Boot Kick T1-T2 and T3 (-35% enemy damage) around ult T3, Bola last.

Item fit: Bullet Lifesteal (1.6k) -> Grit + Spirit Shielding (800+800). Bullet Lifesteal/Vampiric Burst are on none of the tracklock Silver lists; Grit 68% and Spirit Shielding 42% pro. Same 4.8k health spike at Lifestrike. Lane box Grit -> Extra Health (29% pro, tracklock defensives) since Grit is core now.

Item fit: Rapid Rounds -> Burst Fire out (not on any tracklock Silver list; 0.85s cycle, 7-shell mag). Weighted Shots was bought fresh; now Slowing Bullets (37% pro) -> Weighted Shots (48% pro) in that slot, its real component.

Item fit: Toxic Bullets -> Debuff Reducer (56% pro), Vampiric Burst -> Unstoppable (38% pro, tracklock core). Silver has to get on top of people (bola/kick range 10.6m, Point Blank 15m) and stuns are how they stop her. Unstoppable moved out of Counters.

Item fit: Spellslinger (not on any public Silver list; her 4 cooldowns are 21-60s) -> Silencer (tracklock late list). Slowing Hex (49% pro) added in the freed slot; it also takes spirit to 4.8k with Superior Duration.

Item fit: rich box removed: Lucky Shot isn't on any Silver list and Silencer moved into core. Kept: Stalker 98%, Melee Lifesteal 96%/Lifestrike 75%, Close Quarters 60% (Point Blank on the late list), Hunter's Aura 95%, Berserker 59%, Duration Extender (early list)/Superior Duration 36%, Frenzy (late list). Core 43.2k, 12 slots.
Order: ability order set to the a7 data-first order 1234121442431233.

Threshold: no damage-threshold items in the build. Duration Extender is on Lycan Curse (15s duration), Berserker/Spirit Shielding trigger on damage taken, which a frontline wolf takes plenty of. Nothing moved.

Round 9: Restorative Shot added first in lane (tracklock.gg pro Silver, last 30 days to Oct 19: 91% early, 3rd most bought item; RULES: good on spread guns). Slowing Bullets moved into Early to land the 4.8k gun spike (Restorative 800 + Close Quarters 800 + Stalker 1.6k + Slowing Bullets 1.6k, at 5.6k souls, same timing as before) and Point Blank moved to Mid, since pro Silver doesn't buy Point Blank early (Close Quarters 60% early, Point Blank not in the top 8 of any phase). Silencer now sells Restorative Shot. Core 44k.

Round 9: Worth a try box: Melee Charge (Lycan Curse BonusDurationOnHeavyMelee 1.5s, light melee 0.5s, on a 15s form; Melee Charge is +25 heavy melee damage and +10% melee every 5s, same 1.6k as Slowing Hex).

Round 11: added empty 'Lost lane?' box (Lifestrike right after Stalker, to heal off troopers and camps while you catch up). No role pivot: every Silver ability and wolf form feed the gun brawler job. No T4 run (Unstoppable, then Superior Duration breaks it; Frenzy → Silencer is after 30k).
Round 12: Worth a try box removed (Melee Charge: not an item Kieran picked).
Round 12: Lost lane note now says why: Lifestrike heals on heavy melee and still heals at 40% off troopers, so moving it from 9.6k to 6.4k souls is lane sustain when you're behind.
Round 13 (notes policy): notes that restated the item, said 'Upgrades to X' or marked spikes are now empty; kept only tips, situational calls and sells, each checked in the game files.

Round 14: Silencer out of Late core, Inhibitor in before Frenzy (Inhibitor is in all 6 checked Silver builds: LordNM, Silver's Silver, V1's Gun-Tank, EAT RAW FLESH, Animals, silver is solved; Silencer only as a late option). Frenzy now sells Restorative Shot. Rich box added: Phantom Strike (sells Slowing Hex), Diviner's Kevlar (sells Spirit Shielding), Divine Barrier (Dispel Magic is in Counters). Ability order 1234121442431233 -> 1234121444213323, the per-point best fit of the mobalytics grid (Lycan Curse T3 by point 10, Bola 13/14/16). Lost lane caption shortened; Spirit Resilience and Counterspell notes made concrete.
Round 15: Stalker was sold twice (Counters and Divine Barrier): Divine Barrier now sells Dispel Magic (it replaces it).

Round 17: Lane sell notes unified ('Sell it once you're out of slots.'). Divine Barrier rich note 'If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.' (was a restatement of the item). 'Lost lane?' desc ends ', then carry on.' like the other reorder boxes. Debuff Reducer/Unstoppable notes left empty (site no longer fills empty notes).

Round 20: Slowing Bullets and Weighted Shots out (Kieran: never Slowing Bullets; Bola and Slowing Hex already catch people): Hunter's Aura moves into lane after Stalker for the gun 4.8k spike, Express Shot (LordNM core) takes Weighted Shots' Mid slot. Late list filled to ~76k from LordNM's late options: Silencer, Diviner's Kevlar, Phantom Strike, Colossus, then Divine Barrier, each selling the weakest item left.

Round 23: Diviner's Kevlar moved to the top of the late list. Lycan Curse is the ult on a 60s cooldown, so every wolf form gives 1000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, and wolf fire rate scales with spirit (60 + 0.45x).
Round 25: ability order 1234121444213323 -> 1122314443224133 (worked out from the kit for this build's playstyle).
Cost audit: Phantom Strike sells Berserker instead of Slowing Hex, so spirit 4.8k is kept.
